answer: Pay rewards on a long horizon: each epoch's earnings vest over 40 epochs, and until then anyone may file a sybil claim by staking 5% of the disputed sum. If a blind panel upholds it, the farm's unvested pile goes to the claimant. A farm becomes an ocean of bait for bounty hunters, and every quill it runs is one more key whose payout can be clawed back. Tradeoff: honest newcomers wait weeks for liquidity, and failed claimants lose their stake, so weak accusations stay rare.
